scripts.postinstall: if [ -f packages/shared/tsconfig.build.json ]; then mkdir -p node_modules/@veris && ln -sfn ../../packages/shared node_modules/@veris/shared && (cd packages/shared && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json); fi
scripts.dev: mkdir -p node_modules/@veris && ln -sfn ../../packages/shared node_modules/@veris/shared && (cd packages/shared && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json) && (cd apps/web && next dev --port 3000 --hostname 0.0.0.0)
scripts.build: mkdir -p node_modules/@veris && ln -sfn ../../packages/shared node_modules/@veris/shared && (cd packages/shared && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json) && (cd apps/web && next build --webpack) && node scripts/prepare-standalone.mjs
